title: Choose the new look for Camellab
question: The roll assigned Live Notebook. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Live Notebook
options.thesis: The site runs like the notebooks AI students live in: every section is a cell that executes as you scroll to it, so the page visibly computes itself.
materials: Archivo for words, mono only for code and counters
options.viewport: Full screen. A code cell types camellab.about(), its counter spins [*] then lands on [1], and the output streams the giant CAMELLAB title, the lab line and an illustrative live plot drawing behind it; the next cells wait below, unexecuted.
options.risk: Turns into a developer-tool costume if the code is cute; outputs must carry the content for visitors who never open a notebook.

raised.raise: One clock: every animation runs on one shared tempo, so cells execute on the beat, never on random staggers.
Outputs displace: new output pushes the cells below it down instead of fading up in place.
Locked palette: five colours, no gradients or blends anywhere.
Honest states: idle, queued, running, done and error look the same for page cells and for form submits.
Disabled controls carry a diagonal hatch, not just lower opacity.

options.label: Attention Lines
options.thesis: Hover any word in the title and weighted curves draw to the words it attends to; the whole site is linked by the same thin lines.
options.viewport: A full-screen title sentence about the lab, with attention curves drawing between its words on load and following the cursor.
options.risk: Reads as a data-viz gimmick if the lines appear everywhere; the rest of the site has to stay calm.

options.label: Campus Guide Map
options.lineage: illustrated zoo and garden guide maps
options.thesis: About, News and Articles are flat colour areas of one map whose coastline redraws as you scroll.
materials: capsule buttons with a riding chip
options.viewport: A full-screen map: a green headland labelled Camellab, capsules pinned to its coast for News, Articles and Join.
options.case: Fuses cleanly and stays clear, since sections become areas, but nothing in it says AI research.
options.risk: Playful enough to undersell a research lab if the type is timid.

options.label: Step Sequencer
options.thesis: Sections as sixteen lit steps under a chase light.
options.viewport: A sixteen-step row across the screen.
options.risk: Music grammar says nothing about the lab.
options.kept: One shared clock for every animation.

options.label: Ebru Bath
options.kept: New content displaces old instead of fading in.

options.label: Sixteen-Colour Screen
options.thesis: Dithered pixel art with a docked text window.
options.viewport: A pixel sunset with a text window.
options.kept: A locked palette with no blends.

options.label: Glaze Shelf
options.thesis: Samples ranked on a kiln shelf.
options.kept: Named states for everything that is in progress.

options.label: Quote Grammar
options.thesis: Words in straight quotes, hazard stripes, orange tags.
options.viewport: Giant quoted caps across the screen.
options.risk: Fashion costume on a research lab.

canonCard.label: Modern startup landing
canonCard.thesis: What modern landing pages usually ship, done well: big centred headline, soft gradient glow, bento grid of cards, fade-up on scroll.
canonCard.viewport: A centred headline over a soft gradient, two buttons, then a bento grid of news and articles.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from thousands of template sites by design.
